name: Gamma Force in Pit of a Thousand Screams
source:
In a dangerous world, individual superheroes are not enough. Even the best of them - a humanoid made of flame, an elf princess with a mean bow, and a musclebound waterbeast - can't do it all themselves. When they come together, they are the Gamma Force. Can anybody stop them?

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/gamma-force-in-pit-of-a-thousand-screams]MobyGames[/url]]
translation:
在一个危险的世界里，单靠个人超级英雄是不够的。即使是他们中最好的人——由火焰制成的人形生物、拥有卑鄙弓箭的精灵公主和肌肉发达的水兽——也无法独自完成这一切。当它们聚集在一起时，它们就是伽玛力。有人能阻止他们吗？

[来自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/gamma-force-in-pit-of-a-thousand-screams]MobyGames[/url]]
